prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, early 30s goddess, hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size; below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant; enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other; every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass, the sheer weight of the flesh visible in how it spills forward and settles, her body so wide that her hips nearly touch the left and right edges of the frame; real photographic skin with visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, sleek slicked-back teal hair — wearing a minimal sling micro bikini made entirely of glossy jet-black latex, one continuous garment consisting only of a low-rise micro bikini bottom of one tiny opaque black latex triangle on thin side strings of the same material tied at the hips and the straps that rise from its front: from the front center of that bottom a single black latex strap rises straight up over her stomach to the center of her chest, where it divides into two: the left branch runs to her left breast, where the strap itself widens into a wide flat band exactly where it passes over her left breast, fully and opaquely covering her left nipple and areola, then curving up over its shoulder and meeting the other strap behind her neck; the right branch runs to her right breast, where the strap itself widens into a wide flat band exactly where it passes over her right breast, fully and opaquely covering her right nipple and areola, then curving up over its shoulder and meeting the other strap behind her neck, these straps alone covering her chest and leaving the rest of her torso bare, every piece with a mirror-wet latex shine, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare between the straps. Her left arm wears a black lace detached sleeve from her left wrist up to the upper arm, tied with a small satin ribbon bow at the top, her hand and fingers bare, her warm olive skin showing through the lace pattern. Her right arm wears a black leather fingerless glove on her right hand reaching to the middle of the forearm, her fingertips and upper arm bare. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead — most extreme hourglass SSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy black latex, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy black lacquer with a high polish.
Body gems: a delicate line of small clear rhinestone crystals stuck directly on the bare skin along both collarbones, and a second ring of the same crystals around her navel, resting on the skin.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a gold chain ending in a heavy iron weight on one ear and a silver chain ending in a big pearl on the other, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips.

Background: a long white fashion-show runway with a glossy white floor, standard-height steps at the end and softly lit empty rows of seats, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
